summary: Five blocks of work served Qwen3.8-27B (the official AWQ base and the Cold-Fusion community merge) in several builds on one pair: vLLM INT8 and GPTQ INT4 with multi-token-prediction (MTP) speculative decoding at k=2 and k=3, and llama.cpp GGUF with MTP, each measured for single-stream and eight-request throughput, VRAM, tool and reasoning parsers and vision, against same-day paired controls. The GPTQ INT4 build of the merge with MTP k=3 under vLLM tensor parallel 2 was adopted as the pair's served model; the GGUF route gave the best single stream but far lower batched throughput. Raw block outputs only; no frozen bench.
title: Getting the most out of Qwen3.8-27B on one NVLink pair
